# azion_buckets (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azion_buckets" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `counter` (Number) The total count of buckets.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `page` (Number) The current page number.
- `page_size` (Number) The number of items per page.
- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))
- `total_pages` (Number) The total number of pages.

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `last_editor` (String) Last editor of the bucket.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp of the bucket.
- `name` (String) Name of the bucket.
- `product_version` (String) Product version of the bucket.
- `workloads_access` (String) Access type for workloads: read_only, read_write, or restricted.
